title: Value vacuum.
text:
Value vacuum.. Pros:
Cheapest upright I’ve ever seen ($59)
Very light weight.
Easy to setup.
Bag-less.
Good suction.
Works well on carpet.

Cons:
Very bulky, even though it’s light weight.
Feels a bit fragile/cheap. Although nothing has broken, it seems like with heavy use that its likely something will break or wear out.

Warning: When you use the vacuum cleaner, the floor brush may be clogged by hairs and dirts. We recommend cleaning the roller brush and the belt to remove the hairs and dirts every 2 weeks. If the roller and belt not cleaned for a long time, it may cause malfunction, and in some serious cases, there may be the risk of smoke and belt broken.
description: We know you value a clean home and Eureka is proud to offer whole home cleaning solutions to make life a little easier.

EUREKA PowerSpeed Lightweight Powerful Upright Vacuum Cleaner is the ultimate solution to all your cleaning needs! With its impressive suction power and five height adjustment, this vacuum will leave your carpets, rugs, floors, and car interiors spotless.

The lightweight design makes it easy to maneuver, the large capacity dust cup and washable filter ensure less time cleaning and maintenance, and the wide nozzle enables cleaning larger areas in less time, making this pet vacuum cleaner a perfect dorm room essential.

Our various onboard accessories make cleaning pet hair and hard-to-reach areas like lampshades, furniture, and ceilings a breeze. Don't settle for a cheap vacuum that won't get the job done. Invest in our handheld vacuum cleaner today and experience the difference for yourself!
If you have any questions, contact our customer service team at 1-800-282-2886.
Warning: When using the vacuum cleaner, the floor brush may be clogged by hairs and dirt. We recommend cleaning the roller brush and the belt every 2 weeks.
